item.title: You've Been Chopping Broccoli Wrong?!
item.description: Instead of chopping broccoli into florets before boiling, try cooking the whole head first and cutting it afterward. It can make preparation easier and help keep the florets from falling apart!

item.title: You Can Pick Up Boiled Eggs With a Whisk?!
item.description: Instead of struggling to scoop hard-boiled eggs out of hot water, gently press a whisk over an egg to catch it between the wires and lift it out. A surprisingly handy kitchen trick!

item.title: You Can Check Propane Levels With Hot Water?!
item.description: Not sure how much propane is left in your grill tank? Pour warm water down the side, then feel for where the metal turns cooler. That temperature change can help reveal the propane level!
